product: UK Waste Rule & Permit Change-Impact MCP

sources.title: Check if you need an environmental permit
sources.review_note: Reviewed the live Environment Agency/GOV.UK permit-screening page on 2026-10-14. Its current scope still routes potential pollution, flood-risk, drainage, water-resource and listed waste activities to the applicable regulator and distinguishes exclusions from registered exemptions. No decision rule change was identified.

sources.title: Choosing the right waste exemptions for your activity
Waste duty of care: code of practice
sources.review_note: Reviewed the live DEFRA/Environment Agency statutory waste duty-of-care code on 2026-10-14. It continues to apply to people who produce, carry, keep, dispose of, treat, import or control waste in England and Wales and requires safe, responsible handling and transfer only to authorised businesses. No decision rule change was identified.

sources.title: Digital waste tracking service
sources.review_note: Reviewed the live DEFRA policy paper updated 2026-10-01. It confirms phase 1 applies to permitted/licensed receiving sites from October 2026 in England and Wales (January 2027 in Scotland and Northern Ireland); carriers, brokers and dealers are phase 2 with an October 2027 mandatory date; exemptions and green-list exports are later phases. A spreadsheet alternative is expected to remain available until at least October 2027. The existing England receiving-site rule matches this scope.

sources.title: Report receipt of waste
sources.review_note: Reviewed the live DEFRA Report receipt of waste guidance updated 2026-09-25. It confirms the October 2026 start for permitted/licensed receiving organisations, API and prescribed-spreadsheet reporting options, the £26 annual service charge per organisation (covering all its receiving sites), and the first payment deadline of 2027-01-31; later registrations still owe the full amount. These costs do not change the permit/DWT decision rules.

sources.title: Report receipt of waste: choose a software provider
sources.review_note: Reviewed the live DEFRA compatible-software guidance updated 2026-10-02. It says listed providers meet the digital waste tracking requirements, but the list is non-exhaustive; users may choose another provider if it records and submits legally required movement data through the Receipt of Waste API. Production approval test exemptions must be checked with the provider. The preflight does not claim to test or endorse software.

sources.title: Register or renew as a waste carrier, broker or dealer
Waste: environmental permits
sources.review_note: Reviewed the live Environment Agency/GOV.UK waste environmental permits page updated 2026-02-12. It continues to distinguish regulatory position statements, registered exemptions, standard rules permits and bespoke permits, and describes site/mobile plant scope and application routes. The February update added online application information for specified permit categories; no waste-route rule change was identified.
